intervals.label: hosting KATRIN
intervals.note: No source consulted (checked 2026-09-17) gives a founding or opening date for KIT Campus North or the Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe itself; this interval only documents that the site is operating as KATRIN's host, per the experiment's own site.
intervals.quote: the KArlsruhe TRItium Neutrino (KATRIN) experiment, which is presently being performed at Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe on the KIT Campus North site

name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Campus North
notes: No source consulted (checked 2026-09-17) gives a founding or opening date for KIT Campus North or the Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe itself; the sole interval's start (2019) is a lower bound borrowed from KATRIN's own sourced operating start (the earliest dated fact available), not a true facility founding date. A start year is recorded, rather than leaving the interval undated, so that a clearly operating facility is not shown as having no recorded presence.
This record covers KIT Campus North (the Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe site) at the level needed for KATRIN's host-facility role; it is not a full record of KIT as a university/research organisation.

summary.plain: A large German research campus north of Karlsruhe that hosts the Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe, home to the KATRIN neutrino-mass experiment.
summary.technical: KIT Campus North (Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen, Germany) hosts the Tritium Laboratory Karlsruhe, the site of the KATRIN experiment.
